context.content_translation:
随着电子产品销售的激增，行业分析师预计设备到人比率很快将超过早期的预测。
A. 分裂
B. 比例
C. 部分
D. 比率

items.question: With the recent surge in electronic sales, industry analysts are anticipating that the device-to-person ------- will soon surpass earlier predictions.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“ratio”代入题干后为“With the recent surge in electronic sales, industry analysts are anticipating that the device-to-person ratio will soon surpass earlier predictions.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（ratio）。
